name: The Bell That Tolls Itself

rooms.name: Narthex
rooms.description: The heavy doors groan open into a cold vestibule where hymnals lie swollen with damp and the holy water font has long since dried to a dark stain. Somewhere above, the bell tolls once, slow and deliberate, though no rope swings.

rooms.name: Confessional A
rooms.description: A cramped wooden booth, its lattice screen black with age. Something has scratched a single word into the kneeler over and over: FORGIVE.

rooms.name: Choir Loft
rooms.description: The loft sags under the weight of a dust-shrouded organ, its pipes bent like broken fingers. Song sheets still stand open on the rail, though the ink has bled into illegible streaks.

rooms.name: Bell Tower Stairs
rooms.description: A narrow spiral of worn stone steps climbs into darkness, each tread dipped in the middle from centuries of feet. A frayed bell rope hangs dead along the wall, severed cleanly at shoulder height.

rooms.name: Belfry
rooms.description: Cold wind cuts through the open arches of the belfry, where a great blackened bell sways gently in still air. The clapper strikes again on its own, and the sound seems to come from somewhere inside the metal itself.

rooms.name: Nave
rooms.description: Rows of pews stretch toward the altar like a congregation that never left, several overturned or collapsed into rot. Candle stubs cover every ledge, burned down to nothing, and the air smells of cold wax and old earth.

rooms.name: North Aisle
rooms.description: A shadowed walkway runs beneath cracked stained glass, each panel depicting a saint whose face has been deliberately scratched away. Moonlight through the broken panes paints pale shapes on the floor.

rooms.name: South Aisle
rooms.description: Votive racks line the wall, every candle extinguished, their wax pooled and fused into a single grey mass. Faint scratch marks in the flagstones run the length of the aisle, all pointing toward the altar.

rooms.name: Chapel
rooms.description: A small side chapel dedicated to the dead, its walls covered in memorial plaques gone green with verdigris. A child's coffin-sized reliquary stands open and empty at its center.

rooms.name: Chancel
rooms.description: The choir stalls stand in two facing rows, their misericords carved with grinning faces worn smooth by hands. Every hymnal on the stands is open to the same page, though none of them should be.

rooms.name: Sanctuary
rooms.description: The high altar has been stripped bare, its cloth long rotted, and deep gouges score the stone slab as if something tried to climb out from beneath it. A cold draft rises steadily from a hairline crack at its base.

rooms.name: Vestry
rooms.description: Vestments hang from pegs like shed skins, moth-eaten and stiff with mildew. A mirror on the wall is cracked from corner to corner, and someone has blacked out the glass with candle soot.

rooms.name: Parish Hall
rooms.description: Long trestle tables remain set for a feast no one ate, plates furred with mould and chairs pushed back as if the diners rose all at once. A banner above the hearth reads a half-rotted blessing.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: A cold hearth dominates the little kitchen, its iron pots still hung and filled with something best left unexamined. Cleavers and knives are gone from their rack, every single one.

rooms.name: Storage Room
rooms.description: Shelves of candle stubs, altar linen, and stacked donation boxes crowd the narrow room. One box has been pried open and its coins scattered, as if money stopped mattering here very suddenly.

rooms.name: Basement Stairs
rooms.description: Stone steps descend beneath a low arch, the air growing colder and damper with each tread. Scratches on the walls deepen the further down they go.

rooms.name: Crypt
rooms.description: Vaulted burial niches line the low chamber, several stone lids dragged aside from the inside. A rusted iron gate at the far end stands open onto the old churchyard, breathing night air into the dark.

entities.name: Flask of ancient holy water hidden in the altar base
Weakened altar step gives way over a shallow ossuary pit
Rusted knife rack rigged to fall when the door swings wide
Sexton's key ring, including the bell tower master key

goals: Silence the self-tolling bell in the Belfry
Learn the identity of the Bell-Ringer from the parish records
Escape through the churchyard gate in the Crypt
